run_process_eth3d_scene: run the eth3d scene conversion script to convert raw ETH3D data to WAI format with images and depth
run_undistort_depth_maps: run the undistort depth maps function to generate undistorted depth maps from distorted ETH3D raw depth using camera calibration
load_eth3d_raw_depth: load an ETH3D raw depth file as a 4032x6048 float32 numpy array with NaN values replaced by zero
create_pose_matrix_from_quaternion: create a 4x4 camera pose matrix from a quaternion vector with translation and scalar-first rotation components
find_non_gravity_aligned_poses: find camera poses not aligned with gravity by analyzing Y-axis deviation across a set of camera-to-world transformation matrices
